Figure 2: Overview of our proposed PRPO framework. PRPO consists of two core components: (i) Robust Visual Dependency (RVD), which identifies pivotal perceptual tokens through fine-grained trajectory analysis, and (ii) Perceptual Advantage Reshaping (PAR) algorithm, which applies a synaptic S-shaped curve to reshape uniform trajectory-level advantages, dynamically amplifying pivotal perceptual tokens while preserving stable optimization gradients for reasoning tokens.
